page.overview:
Who is Minuette?

Minuette is a female unicorn pony with a Maya blue coat, periwinkle mane and tail with a pigment blue streak, dark blue eyes, and a cutie mark of an hourglass. She makes her first appearance in the pilot episode of the series and has her first speaking role in A Canterlot Wedding - Part 1. Minuette is one of the main characters in Amending Fences, where it is revealed that she was a close friend of Twilight before the latter moved to Ponyville.

Appearing in multiple times in each season of the show, Minuette can also be seen in My Little Pony Best Gift Ever special, IDW comics, and chapter books, where she also has speaking roles. She also has some merchandise, with a toy revealing her name for the first time.

Minuette shares her design with Sea Swirl and Peachy Pitt and her cutie mark with Dr. Hooves. Her name is the feminine form of "minuet", a 17th-century French dance, and is also similar to "minute", a unit of time.

In The Ticket Master, Minuette stands as a part of the audience in the daydreams of Rainbow Dash and Rarity. During Rainbow's fantasy, she stands between Lemon Hearts and Twinkleshine, witnessing Rainbow Dash interrupt the Wonderbolts' performance. Minuette watches Rainbow perform the Super Speed Strut, the Fantastic Filly Flash, and the Buccaneer Blaze. In Rarity's fantasy, Minuette watches Rarity dance with and marry Prince Blueblood. Later in the episode, Minuette appears as one of the ponies trying to extort the gala ticket out of Twilight Sparkle. In Applebuck Season, Minuette drags a banner at town hall, stands next to Fluttershy during the party for Applejack, and mouths, "Mmm, muffins" at the same time as Sea Swirl and Derpy.
